items.q: Who is eligible for the Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: Citizens of over 100 countries are eligible to apply for the Azerbaijan e-Visa online. Most European, North American, and Asian passport holders qualify.

items.q: How long does it take to get an Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: Standard processing takes 3 business days. Urgent processing delivers your approved e-Visa in just 3 hours for an additional fee.

items.q: How much does the Azerbaijan e-Visa cost?
items.a: Pricing depends on your nationality and chosen processing speed — see the country list above for exact fees.

items.q: How long can I stay in Azerbaijan with an e-Visa?
items.a: The Azerbaijan e-Visa allows a single entry with a maximum stay of 30 days, and is valid for 90 days from the date of issue.

items.q: What documents do I need to apply?
items.a: A valid passport with at least 6 months of validity, a digital passport-sized photo, a valid email address, and a payment card.

items.q: Can I extend my Azerbaijan e-Visa?
items.a: The e-Visa cannot be extended online. To stay longer, apply for a new visa or contact the State Migration Service of Azerbaijan.

guide.title: Azerbaijan e-Visa — Complete Guide
guide.intro1: Azerbaijan offers an electronic visa (e-Visa) to citizens of over 100 countries, making it easier than ever to visit this remarkable country at the crossroads of Europe and Asia.
guide.intro2: The entire process takes just a few minutes — fill in your personal and passport details, select your visa type, pay the government fee online, and receive your approved visa by email within 3 hours (urgent) or 3 business days (standard). Your e-Visa is valid for 90 days from the date of issue, allowing a stay of up to 30 days.
guide.whyVisitText: Baku, the capital, blends ultramodern architecture with a UNESCO-listed Old City. The country offers stunning natural landscapes — from the Caucasus mountains to the Caspian Sea coast — rich history, and a rapidly growing tourism infrastructure.

country.heroDescription: A practical, step-by-step look at how {country} passport holders apply for an Azerbaijan e-Visa.
country.overview: Travelers from {country} need an e-Visa before flying to Azerbaijan. Apply online, pay ${fee} USD, and expect your approval within 3 business days — no embassy appointment needed.
country.needVisaBody: Travelers from {country} cannot enter Azerbaijan visa-free — an e-Visa is required before departure. The upside: the whole application runs online, so there's no embassy appointment to book or paperwork to mail in.
country.evisaForBody: Issued to {country} nationals, this is a single-entry electronic authorization suited to tourism, short business trips, or passing through en route elsewhere.
country.bullet1: Submit the form from your phone or laptop, no in-person visit needed
country.bullet2: Choose standard (3 business days) or urgent (3 hours) processing
country.bullet3: One flat fee of ${fee} USD — no hidden charges at the border
country.bullet4: Covers one trip, with a stay of up to 30 days
country.requirementsIntro: Gather these before you open the application form:
country.req1: A {country} passport valid at least 6 months past your planned departure date
country.req2: An email address you check regularly — that's where the e-Visa gets sent
country.req3: A debit or credit card to cover the application fee
country.req4: A recent photo of yourself, passport-style, saved as a digital file
country.validityBody: Once issued, the e-Visa stays valid for 90 days — you can enter Azerbaijan any time within that window, for a single stay of up to 30 days.
country.costBody: Expect to pay ${fee} USD total — that figure already includes the government processing charge, so there's nothing extra due on arrival.
country.faqNeedVisaQ: Is a visa mandatory for {country} citizens visiting Azerbaijan?
country.faqNeedVisaA: Yes — there's no visa-free arrangement for {country} passport holders. The e-Visa is the fastest route in, and it's handled entirely online.
country.faqTimeQ: How fast does approval come through?
country.faqTimeA: Most applications clear in 3 business days. If your trip is closer than that, urgent processing can get you approved in around 3 hours for an added cost.
country.faqDocsQ: What paperwork does a {country} applicant need?
country.faqDocsA: Just four things: a passport with 6+ months of remaining validity, a digital passport photo, a working email, and a card to pay with.
country.faqCostQ: What's the total cost for {country} passport holders?
country.faqCostA: ${fee} USD, all-inclusive — that covers the government fee and processing, with nothing further to pay once you land.
country.faqStayQ: How many days can I spend in Azerbaijan on this visa?
country.faqStayA: Up to 30 days per visit. The e-Visa itself remains valid for entry for 90 days after it's issued.
country.faqExtendQ: Can the e-Visa be renewed or extended after I arrive?
country.faqExtendA: Not online. If your plans change and you need more time, you'd need to either apply for a fresh visa or reach out to Azerbaijan's State Migration Service directly.
country.step1Desc: {country} is on the eligible-country list, so this step is usually a formality — just double-check before you begin.
country.step2Desc: Line up your passport, a digital photo, and a payment card so you're not hunting for them mid-application.
country.step3Desc: Enter your travel and personal details — most applicants finish this part in under 5 minutes.
country.step4Desc: Pay ${fee} USD by card through the secure checkout to move your application into processing.
country.step5Desc: Once approved, the e-Visa lands in your inbox — typically within 3 business days, sooner with urgent processing.
country.readyToApplyDesc: The form takes minutes, and most travelers hear back within days.
